lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce Trial: Mimms' Niece Testifies on Lincoln Park Nonprofit Lease
lead_independence.lead: The corruption trial of former Fort Pierce City Manager Nicholas Mimms, underway at the St. Lucie County Courthouse over a bid process involving two vacant city-owned lots in the Lincoln Park area, moved forward Thursday with testimony from Mimms' niece and a lead FDLE investigator. Earlier proceedings had focused on a parking provision Mimms allegedly promised for the Lincoln Theater that an FDLE agent testified never appeared in the RFP sent to the purchasing department. Thursday's testimony shifted to a nonprofit lease deal at the center of the bid-tampering and official misconduct charges against Mimms.
